verify_detail: clear, testable action inside Catalog (Export) has a logged, deterministic fatal crash.\n\nGiven navigation itself is broken and a core action crashes the app outright, this build should not ship. Recommend blocking release until: (a) the main-menu button click handlers are fixed/rewired to their correct destinations, (b) the catalog list's item-to-detail index binding is fixed, and (c) `ExportPolicy` buffer initialization is fixed (or guarded) before `export()` is invoked from `DetailScreen`."
